semantic_findings.issue: Contract signing event range is not evidence of contract performance period.
semantic_findings.requested_resolution: Change p0052 signing range qualifier from contract_period to other_period and align notes.

semantic_findings.issue: Explicit monthly wage-record periods were inconsistently omitted while one month and aggregate ranges were labeled.
semantic_findings.requested_resolution: Include explicit March/April/May/June/September wage-record periods and literal missing-year 2-9 range; treat same assertion same aggregate range variants as alternatives, never infer missing year or turn payment dates into wage periods.

semantic_findings.issue: Employer alias candidate quoting nested contractor statement was labeled decided.
semantic_findings.requested_resolution: Use claimed for that nested assertion, or another exact independently supported alias location with matching assertion; do not promote from outer finding heading.

semantic_findings.issue: Daily rates were labeled partial without the contract clearly identifying rates as partial amounts.
semantic_findings.requested_resolution: Before inference, use unknown for daily other_amount rates; reserve partial for explicit components/part amounts. Apply same generic rule to development set.

semantic_findings.issue: Merging versus splitting repeated monetary events with different assertion/source roles was inconsistent.
semantic_findings.requested_resolution: Apply predeclared rule consistently: different source speakers or procedural conclusions with different assertion attributes are separate expected; same actor/assertion/event repetition is one expected with exact supported alternatives. Specifically recheck wx14 remaining-arrears party claim and reviewed 104995 finding, split wx50 payment acknowledgment/finding, ly payment claim/finding and yy table narrative/company claim.

semantic_findings.issue: Review independence must be described relative to annotation authorship rather than all application implementation.
semantic_findings.requested_resolution: Disclose prior web/API/storage integration role while recording no material/gold authorship, no scorer/prompt authorship and no model answer access.

semantic_findings.issue: Related insurance coverage/registration and wage-list evidence periods needed consistent coverage without confusing them with wage accrual.
semantic_findings.resolution: Source-supported other_period and literal wage-list year candidates added with attributed assertions; notes retain limits on calculable scope.

semantic_findings.issue: RawCandidate has no hidden claimant/event field, so identical observable tuples cannot be counted repeatedly solely by speaker changes.
semantic_findings.resolution: Contract authoring rules now deduplicate identical kind/value/subject/period/qualifier/assertion same-event tuples, preserve exact alternatives, and split observable attribute changes.

semantic_findings.issue: February wage-record period covers the cohort while the explicit zero applies only to one worker.
semantic_findings.resolution: Period canonical subject is null; only this source-supported period receives the explicit worker sub-scope alternative. Money zero remains strictly tied to the named worker and month; no generic monetary null relaxation.

semantic_findings.issue: Entity alias attribution must follow its own exact quote context.
semantic_findings.resolution: Yc alias uses claimed under respondent answer; gz alias remains claimed with quote expanded to expose nested complaint attribution.

limitations: Official administrative narratives are not primary payroll or bank records.
Family separation does not establish institution/template separation or absence from pretraining.
